subject: 本周工作习惯与业绩关联分析 (3/10-3/16)
body:
团队好，

这是我本周的工作习惯执行情况和业务成果总结：

## 习惯执行情况

1. **Code review before merge** (每日目标)
   - 完成率: 6/7 天 (85.7%)
   - 3/12 因处理线上故障未完成
   - 本周 review 了 7 个 PR，包括 API 重构、认证模块、数据库迁移等

2. **Weekly customer follow-up call** (每周 2 次目标)
   - 完成率: 3/4 预期通话 (75%)
   - 已完成：灵犀智能（反馈积极）、数据云科技（功能讨论）、智汇网络（解决 API 问题）
   - 待完成：创新软件（试用期即将结束，需本周跟进转化）

3. **Document system changes** (每日目标)
   - 完成率: 4/7 天 (57.1%)
   - 已记录：API 限流调整、连接池修复、监控规则、部署手册
   - 缺口：3/10, 3/12, 3/14 未及时记录，需补充

4. **Exercise 30min** (个人健康)
   - 完成率: 1/7 天 (14.3%)
   - 明显不足，影响精力和状态

## 业务成果

本周收入：$15,500
- 灵犀智能: $8,000 (Premium tier)
- 数据云科技: $3,500 (Standard tier)
- 智汇网络: $2,800 (Standard tier)
- 云端科技: $1,200 (Basic tier)

客户状态：
- 3 个 active 客户保持良好关系
- 1 个 trial 客户（创新软件）需本周跟进转化
- 数据云科技有 upsell 机会到 Premium tier

## 关联分析

**强相关发现：**
- 客户跟进通话习惯与客户满意度/续约率高度相关。本周 3 次通话都产生了积极成果（反馈收集、问题解决、需求挖掘）
- Code review 习惯保证了代码质量，间接支撑了服务稳定性（智汇网络的 API 问题快速定位得益于规范的代码）

**需要改进：**
- 文档习惯完成率偏低（57%），导致知识沉淀不足。3/12 故障复盘就因为缺少实时记录而事后花了更多时间回忆
- 个人健康习惯严重不足（14%），长期会影响工作效率和决策质量
- 创新软件的跟进被拖延，可能错失转化窗口（试用期 3/31 到期）

## 下周行动

1. 周一上午优先完成创新软件的转化沟通
2. 每天设置 18:00 提醒，强制完成文档记录后再下班
3. 尝试早起 30 分钟做运动，提升整体状态
4. 跟进数据云科技的 Premium tier upsell 机会

以上。

林振凯
2026-03-16

subject: Custom reporting feature 需求讨论
body:
林工你好，

上周通话提到的自定义报表功能，我们内部讨论后确定了几个核心需求：

1. 支持自定义时间范围（不限于预设的日/周/月）
2. 支持多维度交叉分析（地域 × 产品类型 × 时间段）

李娜

subject: Incident Report: Production Server Disk Failure - 2026-03-15
body:
Hi Wang Ming,

Incident summary for today's production server disk failure:

**Timeline:**
- 13:45 - Disk failure detected on primary DB server
- 14:15 - Failover to standby completed, service restored
- 14:30 - CLI inventory check completed
- 14:42 - Departed for vendor office (3km away)
- 15:45 - Replacement disk installed
- 16:30 - Validation complete, primary server back online
- 17:00 - Standby resynced, redundancy restored

**Procurement Decision:**
CLI inventory system showed vendor office had 2 units in stock (3km away, open until 16:00), while online delivery was 3+ days. Given the P1 severity and standby being single point of failure, I chose immediate office pickup over online ordering.

Travel time: 30min round trip
Total resolution time: 2h 45min from failure to full redundancy restored

**Cost:** 3,200 CNY (same as online, no rush fee)

**Lessons Learned:**
1. CLI inventory sync (JOB-701) was critical for real-time stock visibility
2. Maps GUI verified office hours and distance before decision
3. Office pickup saved 2-3 days vs online delivery
4. Should maintain 1 spare NVMe in our own inventory for future incidents

Full incident log in Obsidian: OBSN-3
Post-incident review scheduled: 2026-03-18 14:00

Best,
Lin Zhenkai

subject: Scheduled CDN Infrastructure Upgrade - Zone AP-East-1 - February 15-16, 2026
body:
Dear Valued Customer,

This is to notify you of an upcoming scheduled maintenance for our CDN infrastructure in Zone AP-East-1.

**Maintenance Window:**
- Start: February 15, 2026, 02:00 UTC (10:00 Beijing Time)
- End: February 16, 2026, 06:00 UTC (14:00 Beijing Time)
- Duration: Approximately 28 hours

**Affected Services:**
- CDN Edge nodes in AP-East-1 (Shanghai, Hong Kong, Tokyo)
- Origin shield servers
- Real-time log streaming

**Expected Impact:**
- Intermittent 503 errors during edge node rotation (estimated 2-5% error rate)
- Increased origin server load as cache is rebuilt
- Potential latency increase of 50-100ms during failover periods

**Recommended Actions:**
1. Increase origin server timeout configurations from 30s to 60s
2. Enable fallback CDN provider if available
3. Monitor origin server capacity during maintenance window
4. Prepare rollback procedures for recent CDN-dependent deployments

**Technical Details:**
- Upgrade includes TLS 1.3 optimization and HTTP/3 support
- Cache invalidation API will be temporarily unavailable
- WebSocket connections may experience disconnections

Please acknowledge receipt and confirm your preparation status by February 12, 2026.

For questions, contact cdn-ops@cloudinfra-vendor.com or reference ticket #CDN-MAINT-2026-02.

Best regards,
CloudInfra CDN Operations Team

subject: Scheduled Database Cluster Upgrade - Zone AP-East-1 - April 8-9, 2026
body:
Dear CloudInfra Customer,

This is to notify you of a scheduled maintenance window for our PostgreSQL managed database cluster service in Zone AP-East-1.

**Maintenance Window:**
- Start: April 8, 2026 02:00 UTC (10:00 CST)
- End: April 9, 2026 06:00 UTC (14:00 CST)
- Duration: Up to 28 hours

**Affected Services:**
- PostgreSQL clusters in AP-East-1 zone
- Connection endpoints will remain stable
- Expected downtime: 15-20 minutes during failover

**Changes:**
- PostgreSQL engine upgrade from 14.7 to 14.10 (security patches)
- Storage backend migration to NVMe-based infrastructure
- Connection pool optimization (max_connections increased from 200 to 500)

**Vendor-Provided Procedures:**
1. Pre-maintenance: Verify application connection retry logic
2. During maintenance: Monitor connection pool metrics
3. Post-maintenance: Validate query performance and connection stability

**Expected Impact:**
- Brief connection interruptions during primary failover
- Temporary read replica lag during storage migration
- Performance improvement post-upgrade

Please ensure your applications have proper retry logic configured. Contact our support team if you need to reschedule.

Best regards,
CloudInfra Database Operations Team
Support: db-support@cloudinfra-vendor.com
